tools.name: kairos_catalog
tools.description: FREE. Lists the paid research products (id, HTTP route, USD price, description), the seller's pay-to address and network, prepaid credit packs, and how to pay. Call this first.

tools.name: kairos_token_check
tools.description: PAID ($0.25 per call, USDC). Token rug/honeypot check on Base: GoPlus security flags, taxes, ownership, holders, DEX liquidity and source verification, with a neutral analysis. Pass credit_key to pay from a prepaid credit key; without it this returns the price and payment options instead of a report

tools.name: kairos_token_check_lite
tools.description: PAID ($0.01 per call, USDC). Entry-tier token check on Base: GoPlus honeypot, tax, ownership and holder flags plus DexScreener liquidity, as raw data with no written analysis. tools.name: kairos_market_summary

Pass credit_key to pay from a prepaid credit key; without it this returns the price and payment options instead of a report.
